verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a GET /v1/models (or equivalent) endpoint for listing the live model catalog programmatically. Groq's OpenAI compatibility and base URL (groq-docs-2, groq-docs-33) are only an adjacent compatibility claim, and the models docs page (groq-docs-3) is a static description of one model, not an API endpoint. An inference API could clearly offer this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented GET /v1/models-style endpoint
